result.title: Qualification
result.content:
# Qualification

Qualification checks run on each found lead BEFORE any paid step, so money is only spent on leads that pass. Each check is on or off, with a mode, a pass rate and a cost per lead. Owner: sales-lead-service. API base: /v1/brands/{id}/offers/{offerId}/qualification.

## Read
- list_qualification_checks → GET .../qualification/criteria: the offer's checks (works on the offer open in the dashboard).
- list_qualification_sources → GET /v1/qualification/catalog: what a check can read.

## Write
- suggest_qualification_checks → POST .../qualification/suggestions: proposes checks. Spends money; new checks are written OFF.
- create_qualification_check → POST .../qualification/criteria. update_qualification_check (on/off, mode) → PATCH .../qualification/criteria/{criterionId}. archive_qualification_check → DELETE .../qualification/criteria/{criterionId}.

## Articulation
- A check turned on costs money on every lead it reads: state the cost per lead and get a yes before turning one on.
- If the user's criterion cannot be expressed as a check, request_staff (POST /v1/staff-requests, repo sales-lead-service).

definition.sourcing: the whole cost subtree of every lead-service lead-serve run of the campaign (screening, reveal, enrichment, email finding and verification)
notCounted: audience list building (apollo-service audience-companies): it belongs to no campaign
definition.leadOrigins: a lead carries EVERY origin that found it: its serve's origin plus the list kind of every audience of the offer (or of no offer) human-service records it a member of (served there, or found there while already taken). Per-origin leads, positive replies and ROI count every lead carrying the origin; offer totals count each lead once (sourceOverlap)
definition.campaignTotal: committed spend of the campaign's runs on its channel slug and every sourcing origin slug (the figure the campaign's outcome reads print)
definition.unrecordedOrigin: a serve or lead that recorded no audience counts under the origin its campaign is proven to source from: a channel serving from one origin only (CRM email), else the lead-provider costs its audience-less runs bought (Apollo only, all before Apollo Buying Signals existed on 2026-10-02 -> Apollo Cold Filters; Apify search only -> Apify Search); otherwise unattributed
definition.outreachAllocation: each campaign's outreach is split evenly over the leads it served; each lead's share counts for every origin that lead carries
